payload.title: Assign Manager promotes the chosen user's users.role to MODULE_MANAGER tenant-wide and Remove Manager never reverts it, so naming someone manager of one module grants manager rights in every module, HR payroll included
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:582-586 (assignModuleManager overwrites users.role with Role.MODULE_MANAGER for any non-admin)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:609 (removeModuleManager only nulls managerId; the promoted role stays)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:299 (assignUserToModule maps a per-module 'manager' to the global Role.MODULE_MANAGER)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/user-lifecycle.service.ts:897-900 (invites accept any canonical role, module roles included, written as the account role at :950)
payload.rule_violated: Plan §2 and the PKG-02 decision rule: users.role is an account role only and the global role never grants module access (D6 pay stays inside HR).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-06, release R3.
